newsitem.title: UK: UK's BCI plans to buy Canada's SMCC.
newsitem.headline: UK's BCI plans to buy Canada's SMCC.

text.p: British heavy building materials supplier Blue Circle Industries Plc said on Tuesday it had signed a letter of intent to buy privately-owned Canadian cement company St Marys Cement Corporation (SMCC).
BCI said SMCC's net sales totalled around C$400 in 1996. It said the proposed deal was subject to regulatory clearances which were expected to take up to three months.
BCI said the acquisition would help BCI towards profitable growth in north America and had "considerable upside" for BCI shareholders. It gave no price for the proposed deal.
